text_block_list.text:
One evening, as I was walking past the station,
I noticed a rather noisy trio.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You'll definitely regret it
if you don't watch today's live!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, wandering great wolf.
Today is the day of promise.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Like I care.
I already told you I'm not going...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hoh... I see. It appears thou hast also
been guided by the Three Goddesses of Destiny.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
In that case, come with us.
For a banquet of madness, the more souls gathered, the better!

We arrived at the live house entrance,
where a large sign read "Grand Revival Live".

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Revival... I see.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: See? The bassist came back!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
This is it, right?
The sound you wanted to hear, Brian-san!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …………kh, that idiot...
(WAAAAAAAHHHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Returned Member
text_block_list.text:
Yo, so you came, Brian!!
Look, I didn't run away!!
I'm still right here!

text_block_list.name: Returned Member
text_block_list.text:
I'll admit it, you showed me up big time!
So now it's your turn!!

text_block_list.name: Returned Member
text_block_list.text: Don't you dare run away from our sound!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …………Keep talking.

Perhaps this band was a particular favorite of hers.
I watched Narita Brian's profile as she enjoyed herself.

text_block_list.name: Band Leader
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Brian-san.
She said that after hearing you play that day,
she found the resolve to return—

text_block_list.name: Returned Member
text_block_list.text:
I can't just stay a loser forever.
—So? How was the performance?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Still not there yet.

text_block_list.name: Returned Member
text_block_list.text:
Tch. Just watch, I'll wipe that smug look off your face soon.
—Alright, guys, let's practice, practice!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Thou hast safely driven back the god of death.
As expected of noble heroes.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Come on, don't hide it!
They were your favorite band, weren't they?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Not really.
They're just less grating on my ears than the rest.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright!
Case closed either way♪
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to their next live too.
I'm looking forward to their next live too, huh?
Maybe we should join with our own band next time?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright!
Case closed either way♪
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to their next live too.
I'm looking forward to their next live too, huh?
Maybe we should join with our own band next time?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'm not looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But you're still gonna go watch, right?
Fufu, Maya is super excited too♪

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, then I shall become the storyteller.
A tale of a certain horse girl who aided in forging a glorious legend—!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Don't need it. Keep your mouth shut.

As she turned away in a huff,
she looked somewhat embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!! I wanna do it, I wanna do it!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Kuku, then my six-stringed apostle clad in great flames shall lend its strength as well!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Say whatever you want.

Narita Brian brushed it off immediately.
Yet somehow, her expression seemed faintly pleased.
